# The same desktop, reinstalled and partly set up again: same hardware (the fingerprint matches the
# record's), same user. Every name, ID and address is invented.
#
# Format: "-- path --" starts a file, whose contents run to the next header. "-- path -> target --"
# makes a symlink and "-- path/ --" an empty folder. Paths are relative to the fake root.

-- proc/self/mountinfo --
25 1 0:24 /@ / rw,noatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,ssd,subvol=/@
-- proc/sys/kernel/hostname --
desktop

EXAMPLE-0001

EXAMPLE-BOARD
-- sys/class/dmi/id/chassis_type --
3

0x10de
-- sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:01:00.0/device --
0x2484
-- sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:01:00.0 -> ../../../devices/pci0000:00/0000:01:00.0 --
-- etc/passwd --
root:x:0:0::/root:/usr/bin/bash
alice:x:1000:1000:Alice:/home/alice:/usr/bin/zsh
-- etc/group --

alice:x:1000:
-- etc/ssh/sshd_config --
PasswordAuthentication no

-- etc/environment --
PATH=/home/alice/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin

-- etc/locale.conf --

-- etc/mkinitcpio.conf --
MODULES=(btrfs)

-- etc/fstab --
UUID=3333-4444 /boot vfat defaults 0 2
UUID=bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000002 / btrfs subvol=/@,noatime 0 0
-- etc/kernel/cmdline --
root=UUID=bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000002 rw quiet
-- usr/local/bin/hello -> /opt/hello/bin/hello --
-- home/alice/.cargo/bin/cargo --
-- home/alice/.config/systemd/user/rclone-mount.service --
[Unit]
Description=Mount the cloud drive

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rclone mount cloud: /home/alice/Cloud --log-file=/home/alice/.cache/rclone.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
-- home/alice/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/rclone-mount.service -> ../rclone-mount.service --
-- home/alice/Cloud/ --
-- var/lib/systemd/linger/ --
